sources.origin: Teck operational review and updated outlook

claims.claim: QB Q2 2026 production of 55,800 tonnes and no TMF-related concentrator downtime represent measurable execution improvement versus the 2025 operational review that cut 2026 QB guidance to 200,000-235,000 tonnes because TMF development constrained output.

risks: 2026 guidance was reset materially lower after 2025 problems
future TMF or recovery shortfalls could again constrain production
contradictions: Three stable quarters support recovery, but the company explicitly warned in 2025 that TMF and recovery execution could impair 2026-27 output; both facts should remain live.
unknowns: whether QB exits 2026 at sustainable design-rate economics
whether current copper prices normalize before operating improvements fully mature

recommendation.reason: Execution evidence supplies a before/after operating test suitable for causal and risk review.
